notes.title: New Beta Version
notes.notes:
Hello,

a new Beta Version for Push The Crate is now available in the new publicBeta branch.

The new version changes how Achivements are triggered and from the current log files - all achievments get triggered.

Please take a short look into this beta (only ~25mb update size) and report your experience.

notes.title: Update v30300 released!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Polygon Art has taken over the development from Push The Crate as the original developer is defunct and no longer exists.

We want to start supporting Push The Crate with new updates over the next months. Please remember that this is only a small side project with low priority.

This update is a very first, little step to improve the game and please don't expect that all (of the many issues) are now resolved. Please report your current experience with the game.

[b]Changelog:[/b]
[code]
[list]
    [*]Updated to Unreal Engine 4.16
    [*]Reworked Steamwork Integration
    [*]Updated Achievement integration
    [*]Updated Foliage distance
    [*]Updated several Materials to UE 4.16 standards
    [*]Fixed several code warnings and errors
[/list]	
[/code]

notes.title: Update v30250 released!
notes.notes:
A new version of Push the Crate is now live!

[code]
- updated to Unreal Engine 4.14
- updated Steamworks integration
- activated Steam Cloud
- fixed glitch where it was possible that the crate moves out of bounds
[/code]
